auth.description:
Connect your Teamhood account to use this piece.

**How to get your credentials:**
1. Log in to your Teamhood account at https://app.teamhood.com.
2. Open **Settings → Integrations → Teamhood API**.
3. Copy your  API key.
4. Your **API URL** is shown on the same page. It looks like `https://api-YOURTENANT.teamhood.com` — replace `YOURTENANT` with the subdomain from the URL you use to log in.

ownerId.description: Only return items owned by this user.

completed.description: Filter by completion. Leave empty to return both.

createdSince.description: Only return items created after this UTC date/time.

modifiedSince.description: Only return items modified after this UTC date/time.

completedSince.description: Only return items completed after this UTC date/time.

includeChildItems.description: Include child items (sub-tasks) in the results.

take.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.

skip.description: Number of items to skip — useful for pagination.

aiMetadata.description: Searches Teamhood items, optionally narrowed by workspace, board, row, status, assignee, owner, completion state, and created/modified/completed-since timestamps; with all filters left empty it returns items broadly. Use to look up or enumerate items matching criteria, or to resolve an item ID before another action. Supports take/skip pagination (defaults to 100). Read-only and idempotent.

zh.Connect your Teamhood account to use thi:
Connect your Teamhood account to use this piece.

**How to get your credentials:**
1. Log in to your Teamhood account at https://app.teamhood.com.
2. Open **Settings → Integrations → Teamhood API**.
3. Copy your  API key.
4. Your **API URL** is shown on the same page. It looks like `https://api-YOURTENANT.teamhood.com` — replace `YOURTENANT` with the subdomain from the URL you use to log in.

pt.Connect your Teamhood account to use thi:
Conecte sua conta do Teamhood para usar esta peça.

**Como obter suas credenciais:**
1. Faça login na sua conta de equipe em https://app.teamhood.com.
2. Abra **Configurações → Integrações → API de equipe**.
3. Copie sua chave de API.
4. Sua **URL da API** é mostrada na mesma página. Parece que `https://api-YOURTENANT.teamhood.com` — substitua `YOURTENANT` pelo subdomínio a partir da URL que você usa para acessar.
